name: list-box
title: List box
description: A list of options shown in place, not in a dropdown: pick one or several.

when: A short set of options that should stay visible: a settings choice, a filter list.

instead.when: The choice can live in a dropdown.
Rows of content with their own actions.
Two to five options with a line of detail.

builtIn: Arrows move, typing jumps to an option, Space selects; selected options are marked and say so.
